name: vault-librarian
description: Substrate plugin for basic-harness — auto-bootstraps a notes vault on first need, recalls relevant prior pages before each substantive skill runs, and appends new pages after. Three internal skills (vault-companion-ensure / vault-companion-recall / vault-companion-append) that reflection-session, business-mentoring, news-digest, and fintech-legal-triage call as sub-skills. One user-facing command (/vault-librarian:bootstrap-vault) for explicit setup with persona-tuned schemas (researcher / writer / generic / personal). Cross-platform — Claude Code Desktop and Cowork, macOS and Windows. Companion to upstream obsidian-wiki plugin; uses obsidian-wiki:ask for recall when installed, grep fallback when not.
